title: Sunny with a Chance of Asteroids
description: Extend the Intcode computer with parameter modes, I/O, and conditional jumps, then run diagnostics.
writeup:
## Approach

This puzzle extends the Day 2 Intcode computer significantly. The shared `intcode.py` module now handles parameter modes, I/O, comparisons, and jumps.

### New features added to Intcode
- **Parameter modes**: each parameter can be position (mode 0, dereference) or immediate (mode 1, literal). Modes are encoded in the upper digits of the opcode value.
- **I/O**: opcode 3 reads from an input queue, opcode 4 writes to an output list.
- **Jumps**: opcodes 5 (jump-if-nonzero) and 6 (jump-if-zero) enable branching.
- **Comparisons**: opcodes 7 (less-than) and 8 (equals) store 0 or 1.

## Part 1

Run the TEST program with input `1` (air conditioner system ID). It performs diagnostic checks (all should output 0) then outputs the final diagnostic code.

## Part 2

Run the same program with input `5` (thermal radiator system ID). This exercises the new comparison and jump instructions. Only one output is produced — the diagnostic code.
